title: Fastify #4579: crash when onReady hook throws

error_signal.message: fastify Error: server crashes with unhandled exception when onReady lifecycle hook throws an error during startup

ground_truth.root_cause_description: onReady hook errors are not caught properly, causing the server to crash instead of emitting the error through the proper error handling chain.
ground_truth.fix_description: Add try-catch around onReady hook execution in hooks.js
